# Registry

Mirrors shadcn-ui/ui `apps/v4/registry` (see `docs/UPSTREAM.md`).

## Authored

- `bases/base/components/_registry.ts` — atoms (`registry:component`); sources in `src/components/atom/`
- `bases/base/blocks/_registry.ts` — templates (`registry:block`); sources in `bases/base/blocks/<name>/`
- `bases/base/registry.ts` — aggregates and validates with `shadcn/schema`
- `../examples/base/*.tsx` — docs demos (`<ComponentPreview name="x-demo" />`)

## Generated by `pnpm registry:build` (don't edit)

- `__index__.tsx`, `__components__/`, `__blocks__.json`
- `../examples/__index__.tsx`, `../examples/__components__/`
- `/registry.json` and `/public/r/<name>.json` (via `shadcn build`)

Screenshots: `pnpm registry:capture [names]` → `/public/r/styles/base-vega/`.
